messages:
Maya (CSM): Hi all, kicking off onboarding for Pri's team at ArcadiaHealth. Target pilot: 6 weeks. Need owners, quick wins, and any obvious renewal risks.

Pri (Customer): Thanks Maya. Internal stakeholders: Noor (SRE), Ben (Data Eng), and Claire (Compliance). We'll need a sandbox with realistic PII redaction.

Dev (Solutions Eng): I'll own integration. Requesting sample payloads, expected qps, and whether they need streaming responses.

Ola (Success Ops): I'll run enablement and the adoption playbook. Need top 20 use cases and 10 blocked scenarios by EOW.

Ravi (Product): Proposed success metrics: p95 latency <220ms, accuracy on our shared eval >=0.9, and pilot CSAT >=4/5.

Hana (Security): If PII is involved we need a data-flow diagram and retention policy. Flagging possible Private deployment if on-prem processing is required.

Pri (Customer): We anticipate moderate qps (50-200) and prefer non-streaming for MVP. I'll share payload samples after internal signoff.

invite-bot: Calendar "ArcadiaHealth Pilot Kickoff" Thu 11:00am PT created - link: https://calendar.internal/e/arcadia-kickoff

Maya (CSM): Timeline draft:
- Week 0: kickoff + discovery
- Week 1: creds & sandbox
- Week 2: integration + smoke tests
- Week 3: enablement workshop + evals
- Week 4: pilot ramp
- Week 5: monitor & iterate
- Week 6: go/no-go + renewal signal

Ola (Success Ops): Renewal-risk triggers suggestion: escalate if adoption <35% of target by Week 4 OR incident >1 severe production bug. Escalation: CSM -> Solutions Eng -> AM.

Dev (Solutions Eng): Action items: I will send integration template and a short troubleshooting doc (auth, schema mismatch, rate limiting).

Maya (CSM): Pri to confirm sandbox creds and compliance notes. Hana will confirm data gating. I'll create JIRA epic and share link in this thread by EOD. Next status update Friday. Thanks everyone :rocket:
